q: Can I donate online right now?
a: Not yet — the NGO's bank account is still being opened, so online donations are disabled. See the Support Us page for other ways to help: volunteering, supplies, or contacting the team.

q: How will donations be verified when they open?
a: Donors will pay by UPI or bank transfer and submit a payment reference. Staff will confirm each gift only after matching the bank credit. Pending gifts never count toward totals.

q: Will I get a tax receipt?
a: No tax deduction is promised. When donations open, confirmed gifts will receive a plain acknowledgement — not a tax certificate. Any tax-related wording needs confirmed eligibility and approved text.
Fill in the volunteer form with your name, a way to reach you (email or phone), your area, interests and availability. The team reviews every application and replies.

q: Where can I see what the NGO actually does?
a: The gallery shows photographs from the team's work. Programs, impact figures and reports are published only after the NGO approves them — anything still in draft stays private.
